name: work-with-creators-brief-writer
description: Writes a one-page brief for one creator you have already picked: hook ideas in their format, at most three approved must-say lines, never-says, the disclosure for their platform, deliverables, timeline, the usage-rights ask and two examples. Adds a short first-message draft (gift and paid versions) for you to send. Use alone when you already have the creator, their best fitting post and the goal; otherwise run work-with-creators.
